BluePearl Pet Hospital – serving the greater Fox Valley.
We are located in Appleton near the intersection of I41 and W Prospect Ave, and we serve pets and their families throughout the Fox Valley area south of Green Bay.
Our reviews.
Our services.
When your pet needs emergency care, seconds count. Our team is ready to provide expert care 24/7 in case of a pet emergency. If your pet requires a veterinary specialist, we are ready for that too. Our experienced team of veterinarians, vet technicians and support staff work closely together to provide the comprehensive, compassionate care your pet needs and deserves.
Emergency
We’re always ready to provide remarkable medical care for pets in need of emergency care. Our compassionate emergency team members are trained to handle even the most critical cases with expertise and skill. From urgent, life-saving care to ongoing monitoring and support, our emergency team will always be there for you and your pet. Our hospital is staffed by knowledgeable emergency clinicians and technicians with life-saving resources and technology.
While there is no appointment necessary for our pet emergency services, please call ahead and let us know you’re coming.
Specialty care
BluePearl offers a variety of specialty services for pets with complex conditions. Similar to a human hospital, our specialty services are available by referral from your pet’s primary veterinarian or our emergency department. Our state-of-the-art facility is home to specialty teams that work closely with you and your family veterinarian to understand your pet’s specific medical needs and develop a comprehensive care plan for lifelong health.

Testimonials.
Our mischievous 1-year-old cat, Tom, decided it would be a good idea to eat part of our foam floor mat in our workout room. I knew something was wrong when he vomited multiple times and started to become lethargic. The talented staff at BluePearl in Appleton were quick to find out where the foam was stuck in his small intestine by radiograph, then successfully removed the foam chunk during an exploratory laparotomy. Tom is 5 days out from his big surgery and back to his normal kitten-like self. It’s been tough keeping him from trying to run, jump and play so he can safely heal, though! We are so thankful for the staff at BluePearl for saving our boy.
Read More
Emily W.
Our 2-year-old sheltie Mae was in critical condition from a liver shunt. It was a do-or-die situation for her, and without the expertise and care by the staff at BluePearl, we would have lost our little girl. After surgery, a 3-day stay in the hospital, and post-surgery treatment with 8 different medications, we are happy to say, she is a healthy, thriving 3-year-old with a ton of energy and a long life ahead of her. Thank you, BluePearl, you saved her life, and we are forever grateful!
